item.title: Fans get lifetime bans for NBA Finals selfie quest...
item.author: Ben Golliver
item.description: Two fans involved in a selfie-seeking incident during Game 1 of the NBA Finals on Wednesday night have been given lifetime bans from all NBA arenas, a league spokesperson said Thursday.

item.title: Trump to attend NBA Finals Game 3 in New York
item.author: Ben Golliver
item.description: President Trump said Thursday that he has accepted an invitation from New York Knicks owner James Dolan to attend an NBA Finals game at Madison Square Garden next week.

item.title: Fan storms court, attempts selfie next to Wemby
item.author: Ben Golliver
item.description: A fan ran onto the Frost Bank Center court during the fourth quarter of Wednesday night's NBA Finals and attempted to take a selfie with Victor Wembanyama, halting play before the Knicks' 105-95 Game 1 victory.

item.title: Knicks mum on Robinson's status for Game 1
item.author: Ben Golliver
item.description: The Knicks listed backup center Mitchell Robinson as questionable for Game 1 of the NBA Finals against the Spurs on Wednesday due to a broken finger.
